note: Captured 2026-08-30 in a Debian bookworm container (node:22-bookworm-slim, aarch64, tmux 3.3a, node 22.23.2, non-root, `docker run --init`) — Debian and Ubuntu's packaged tmux, and so WSL2's. Same probe as the 3.7c fixture. `perField` is correct; every `joined` form is wrong in the same way, because this tmux replaces each non-printable byte in `display-message -p` output with `_` — so U+0001, a newline and a tab all collapse eight fields into one. That is the 0.23.5 bug: `claude-jam adopt` reported a pane that exists as missing on every Debian/Ubuntu box.
